title: Cabin John lots, Falls Road colonials, and why long trunks hide pollen you never see
headline: Cabin John lots, Falls Road colonials, and why long trunks hide pollen you never see
description: Potomac, MD sits on large wooded lots along the river corridor. why canopy pollen and humidity load estate-scale ducts.

sections.heading: Potomac’s lots are the indoor-air problem
paragraphs: Cabin John and Glen Echo toward the river, Potomac Village and Falls Road, then Avenel: colonials, contemporaries, and additions on wooded lots. Shade keeps crawls and basements cool while the river corridor stays wet. Oak, maple, and pine dump pollen onto every patio each spring. Returns pull it in. Long supply runs in big houses hide dust you never see from the living room.

When a humid week hits, cool trunks sweat and that pollen film turns musty on the first AC cycle. Neighbors sometimes ask about [Great Falls](/locations/great-falls) across the water — those Virginia jobs dispatch from Burke. This page stays on the Maryland side.

sections.heading: Estate-scale runs collect what short ranches never hold
paragraphs: A Bethesda rambler might have twenty feet of trunk. A Potomac house can have wings, a guest suite, and a dryer that travels the length of a lower level. Lint and pollen settle at every joint. You smell it before you see it.
If registers look dirty a few days after you wipe them, when you are ready to book, use the [Potomac, MD location page](/locations/potomac).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Potomac house
listItems: Musty air from a walk-out or crawl after a humid river week.
Pollen film on supplies even with a new filter.
A dryer that never quite finishes on a long lower-level run.

Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear long dryer runs about once a year.

faq.a: When musty startup smells return each humid week, or cool Potomac trunks keep turning dust into a sticky film.

faq.q: Does a dehumidifier replace duct cleaning in Potomac?
faq.a: Lower humidity helps Potomac basements, but it does not remove debris already sitting in trunks. Cleaning and moisture control work together.
